blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Friday said that the running mate she wants for the 2028 national elections has not yet decided on the vice-presidential bid. This was the response of Duterte when asked for the qualifications she is looking for as her running mate in the 2028 national and elections as she already declared her presidential bid as early as February this year. “Yung kinausap ko ha but until now he’s not yet decided,” Duterte said in a press conference.
